newsitem.title: INDIA: India Shaw Wallace to sell cosmetic unit.
newsitem.headline: India Shaw Wallace to sell cosmetic unit.

text.p: Indian liquor maker Shaw Wallace and Company Ltd said on Monday it plans to sell cosmetics division Calcutta Chemicals Company Ltd after its performance status was upgraded by a government agency.

Shaw Wallace said in a statement that the Board of Industrial and Financial Reconstruction (BIFR), which approves proposals for revival or closure of companies suffering severe losses, had said Calcutta Chemicals was no longer "sick".
Under Indian laws, a company is declared sick if its accumulated losses exceed the company's net worth.
"This development has paved the way for Shaw Wallace to sell off CCCL (Calcutta Chemicals Company Ltd) to the party offering the best price," the statement said.
